title_zh: 确定模型船承重实验的水量和记录方法

scenario.label_zh: 确定模型船承重实验的水量和记录方法
scenario.goal_zh: 核对水量单位，约定逐个增加相同砝码并记录模型船下沉情况

context_zh: 两名学生使用教师准备的水箱和模型船规划课堂实验。
author: author-phase07-c

sentences.speaker: Ava
sentences.text: The instruction sheet says to use one gallon of water. Is this jug the right size?

sentences.speaker: Noah
sentences.text: Yes. The jug and the sheet both say US gallon, so we are using the same measure.

sentences.speaker: Ava
sentences.text: Will the boat float with all six weights in it?

sentences.speaker: Noah
sentences.text: We do not know yet. Let us add one weight at a time rather than all six at once.

sentences.speaker: Ava
sentences.text: At the start, only a small fraction of the boat is below the water.

sentences.speaker: Noah
sentences.text: Take a photo of that first. We can record the number of weights and how low the boat sits after each step.

sentences.speaker: Ava
sentences.text: Good. We will use the identical weights the teacher gave us.

sentences.speaker: Noah
sentences.text: And keep the water level the same throughout the test.
